scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India on September 29, 2020. 

This scheme aims to enhance the fish production and promote the welfare of fishers and fish farmers across the country. 

The scheme is part of the broader Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana which has a total outlay of ₹20,050 crores. 

The specific component of the scheme known as Motor Cycle with Ice Box is particularly focused on the state of Haryana. 

This initiative is designed to facilitate the transportation of fish from the production sites to the markets. 

The primary objective of this component is to improve the livelihoods of fishers by providing them with the necessary tools for efficient fish marketing. 

The scheme aims to increase fish production in Haryana by 10 percent over the next five years. 

It also seeks to enhance the income of fishers by providing them with better access to markets. 

The targeted beneficiaries of this scheme are fishers, fish farmers, and those involved in the fish marketing sector. 

Eligible beneficiaries must be residents of Haryana. 

They should be engaged in fishing or fish farming activities. 

The age limit for eligibility is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required for this scheme. 

However, beneficiaries must possess a valid fishing license issued by the relevant authorities. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme includes a subsidy for the purchase of a motorcycle equipped with an ice box. 

The subsidy amount can go up to ₹50,000 per beneficiary. 

This subsidy is aimed at reducing the financial burden on fishers and encouraging them to invest in better transportation facilities. 

The application process for the Motor Cycle with Ice Box component is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must visit the official website of the Department of Fisheries, Haryana. 

They need to fill out the application form available online. 

The application form requires details such as name, address, age, and details of fishing activities. 

Beneficiaries must also submit a copy of their fishing license along with the application. 

Additional documents may include proof of residence and identity verification. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Beneficiaries may be required to provide additional information if requested. 

The processing time for applications is typically around 30 days. 

Upon approval, the subsidy amount will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary’s bank account. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Fisheries, Haryana. 

The contact details for the department are available on their official website. 

Beneficiaries can reach out for assistance or clarification regarding the application process. 

The scheme is expected to be operational throughout the year. 

However, the disbursement of funds may follow a specific schedule based on the number of applications received. 

The initiative is part of the larger vision of the Government of India to promote sustainable fishing practices. 

It aligns with the National Fisheries Policy which aims to increase fish production to 22 million metric tons by 2024. 

The Motor Cycle with Ice Box component is crucial in achieving this target by improving the supply chain. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of reducing post-harvest losses in the fish sector. 

By providing fishers with better transportation options, the scheme aims to ensure that fish reaches the market in a fresh and marketable condition. 

This is particularly important in Haryana where fish consumption is on the rise. 

The initiative also aims to create awareness about the nutritional benefits of fish among consumers. 

By improving the livelihoods of fishers, the scheme contributes to the overall economic development of rural areas in Haryana. 

The Government of Haryana is committed to supporting the fishery sector through various initiatives. 

The Motor Cycle with Ice Box component is one of the many efforts to uplift the fishing community. 

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of fishers across the state. 

It is anticipated that with better transportation facilities, fishers will be able to access larger markets. 

This will ultimately lead to an increase in their income and improved standards of living. 

The scheme also encourages the adoption of modern fishing practices. 

By facilitating better market access, it promotes the idea of entrepreneurship among fishers. 

The Government of Haryana is also working on providing training and capacity building for fishers. 

This is to ensure that they are equipped with the necessary skills to take advantage of the opportunities presented by the scheme. 

The Motor Cycle with Ice Box component is a step towards modernizing the fishery sector in Haryana. 

It reflects the government's commitment to enhancing the socio-economic conditions of fishers. 

The scheme is expected to play a pivotal role in transforming the fishery landscape in the state. 

As the scheme progresses, it will be monitored for its effectiveness and impact on the fishery sector. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be crucial in making necessary adjustments to the scheme. 

The Government of Haryana aims to ensure that the benefits of the scheme reach the intended beneficiaries effectively. 

Overall, the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box is a significant welfare initiative. 

It is designed to empower fishers and promote sustainable fishing practices in Haryana. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a robust fishery sector that contributes to the economy. 

The initiative is a testament to the government's focus on improving the livelihoods of marginalized communities. 

It is expected to bring about positive changes in the lives of fishers across the state. 

The scheme is a part of the larger vision of the Government of India to promote inclusive growth. 

The Motor Cycle with Ice Box component is a vital tool in achieving this vision for the fishery sector.
